candidates.title: EdgeMoE: Empowering Sparse Large Language Models on Mobile Devices
candidates.reason: Focused on-device MoE inference engine using storage hierarchy, expert preloading, and adaptive bit-width decisions to reduce sparse-model inference latency under mobile resource constraints.

candidates.title: CacheGen: KV Cache Compression and Streaming for Fast Large Language Model Serving
candidates.reason: Focused KV-cache compression and streaming system for context reuse, directly addressing network/storage transfer cost in LLM serving.

candidates.title: EAGLE-3: Scaling up Inference Acceleration of Large Language Models via Training-Time Test
candidates.reason: Strong speculative-decoding method that improves draft-token prediction with training-time feature integration and materially advances a core inference-acceleration lineage.

candidates.title: LLM Inference Unveiled: Survey and Roofline Model Insights
candidates.reason: Systems-oriented inference survey distinguished by roofline-model analysis of compute, memory, and hardware bottlenecks plus an open-source inference analyzer.

candidates.title: EAGLE-2: Faster Inference of Language Models with Dynamic Draft Trees
candidates.reason: Focused speculative-decoding contribution using dynamic draft trees to adapt speculation to token confidence and improve lossless generation speed.
